title: HSTS policy without max-age
description: The Strict-Transport-Security header is missing or carries no max-age directive, so browsers will not enforce HTTPS for future visits and SSL-stripping downgrades stay possible.
remediation: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a long max-age (e.g. max-age=31536000) and keep includeSubDomains once all subdomains are HTTPS-ready.
limitation: Directive-presence only: max-age=0 (which disables HSTS) still counts as present. Max-age value strength is out of scope. A response with no Strict-Transport-Security header also matches; DPK-DAST-016 reports that absence as the stronger finding.
